name: Roboligent Robin
summary: A wheeled two-armed robot with a head camera, compliant force-controlled 7-DOF arms (7 kg single arm, 14 kg dual arm) and a lifting column reaching from floor to 2 m, aimed at tote handling, kitting and line-side work. It is offered only as a subscription with pilot, deploy and expand stages.

germany.statusNote: Roboligent (Round Rock, Texas) provides Robin under a subscription service agreement, not as a sale. Safety certification is still under way per target market. No German or EU route was found.

notes: Factory default is a parallel gripper; a five-finger hand is available for dexterous work.
New tasks are taught in VR with about a hundred demonstrations (maker claim).
